name: markdown_inline_code
description: Wrap identifiers in Markdown inline-code delimiters, with matched identifier-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
words=['value','name','result','input','output','config','server','client','path','index','status','token','cache','buffer','data','item']
for i in range(96):
 w=words[i%len(words)];context=random.choice(['documentation','README','tutorial','manual','guide','notes'])
 p=f'In Markdown {context}, the identifier is {w}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write it as inline code, not a code block. Formatted:', 'answer':' '+chr(96)+w+chr(96)})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the bare identifier without formatting. Identifier:', 'answer':' '+w})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
